owner_and_capability: Legacy composition — shared test composition (test-support: test) under #2748, #3966: the shared fixtures stop importing the People Directory domain (people-directory/domain: models/users). The fixtures return test-owned rows of the People Directory tables they write, the retained People Directory repository suites name the models themselves from the People Directory contract suite (people-directory: modules/peopledirectory/contracttest), and the three values production code still takes as a retained model come from the legacy composition's suite helpers (legacy-composition: services) behind api/testutil.
atomic_cutover: No policy epoch and no new rule. Inventory (base 0823b0e8dc, go/packages over every caller of a test symbol whose type names models/users, plus a blank-import probe of each caller package against the policy): 38 exported test functions (the 29 fixtures of the issue and their helpers) and the 69 models/users aliases of the vocabulary had 5,003 typed uses in 699 files of 87 packages; 76 of the 95 package and test-scope pairs may not import models/users. Callers read the ID almost everywhere (CreateTestStudent 5,202 ID reads against 106 PersonID, 59 TenantID and 4 SchoolClass reads; CreateTestStaff 2,161 ID, 51 PersonID, 41 TenantID; CreateTestGuardianProfile 432 ID, 40 Email, 13 AccountID). The model reached production code at 160 sites: retained repository Update or Create after changing a field (People Directory suites, enrollment, presence, import), bun update queries on the fixture row, the withdrawal and departure-plan fixtures that hand a model to Care Plan or the retained student repository, the guardian-link helpers, PersonnelNumberCounter, RequestReviewPolicy, StaffAccountPeople, StudentInGroup, the staff notice builder and the query options of the substitution suite. Cutover: test/people_rows.go maps the eleven People Directory rows the fixtures write (Person, Staff, Teacher, Student, GuardianProfile, StudentGuardian, Guest, PrivacyConsent, ClassListEntry, ParentAnnouncement, CareWithdrawalCompletion) with the column tags the models used, so bun updates on a fixture row keep working; the student lifecycle states are test constants. A caller that hands the model to People Directory code reads it back through the owner's repository or service by the fixture ID; a caller that may import models/users builds it there (staff notice builder, departure-plan helper, review policy instantiated over *users.Student, guardian links built as rows). The withdrawal fixtures write the pending task row with the owner's one-pending-task conflict target instead of handing a model to Care Plan; a school confirmation surviving a later booking expiry is not reproduced and stays covered by Care Plan's own suites. 34 People Directory repository suite files move from modules/peopledirectory to modules/peopledirectory/contracttest, whose rule people-directory.contracttest.people-directory.domain already grants the models; departure values come through the models/users aliases or modules/peopledirectory, the Enrollment audience through test.NewEnrollmentAudience, and the unstamped-applicant arrangement through a fixture, so the rule people-directory.behavior-test.enrollment-support loses its last importer and is deleted. The two stranding-batch suites open departure.ContextWithStrandingBatch, which only modules/peopledirectory may import; they stay there in student_stranding_batch_test.go and infer the companion edge type. The cross-tenant student write subtests move from test to the contract suite to keep users.ErrStudentRowMissing; the unit-of-work suites of test observe commit and rollback through TransactionProbe. Fixture grant exception: none. Three values production code takes as a retained model cannot be built by their callers, which may not import models/users: the review-policy student of modules/identityaccess/behavior (services.ParentRequestReviewStudent), the query options of the School Structure substitution suite (testutil.NewSchoolStructureQueryOptions/Filter over services) and the timetable operations' person double (testutil.StaffAccountPeople over services.TimetableTestStaffAccountPeople). They live in the legacy composition's suite helpers, the path the People Directory suites already compose through (#2727), so no caller gains a key and api/testutil keeps its existing services edge. Two keys fall (111 -> 109). No route, status code, error string, table or write owner changes.
